units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10b:12">Ab. Zar. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>מי שעלתה לו נ׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. <he>שעלה … נימא</he>, corr. acc.) if one has an ulcer on his foot, shall he have it cut and live, or let it go and die?—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 46:10">Gen. R. s. 46</cite> <he>עלתה נ׳ בבשרם וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>נמי</he>) they have an ulcerating sore …, and the physicians advice circumcision.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 46:10">Ib.</cite> (play on <he>ונ̇מ̇ל̇ת̇ם</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 17:11">Gen. XVII, 11</cite>) <he>כנ̇ומ̇י היא ת̇ל̇ויה בגוף</he> it (the prepuce) is like an eating sore hanging from the body.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 45:1">Sifré Deut. 45</cite> <he>ואם … הרי אתה מעלה נימי</he> (corr. acc.) but if thou removest it (the plaster), thou wilt cause ulceration; <cite ref="Kiddushin 30b:3">Kidd. 30ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
